mapper.select: SELECT id,attempt_id,bundle_hash,phase FROM pf.checkpoint WHERE task_id=#{task,jdbcType=OTHER} AND manifest_version=2 ORDER BY created_at DESC,id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT id,space_id,creator_id user_id,conversation_id,status,reason_code,cancel_requested,version,recovery_revision revision,execution_deadline_at deadline,trace_id FROM pf.task WHERE id=#{id,jdbcType=OTHER}
SELECT * FROM pf.checkpoint WHERE task_id=#{task,jdbcType=OTHER} AND manifest_version=2 ORDER BY created_at DESC,id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM pf.checkpoint WHERE task_id=#{task,jdbcType=OTHER} AND id=#{id,jdbcType=OTHER} AND manifest_version=2 AND status='COMMITTED'
SELECT * FROM pf.checkpoint_recovery WHERE command_id=#{command,jdbcType=OTHER}
SELECT * FROM pf.checkpoint_recovery WHERE task_id=#{task,jdbcType=OTHER} ORDER BY revision DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM pf.checkpoint_recovery WHERE target_attempt_id=#{attempt,jdbcType=OTHER}
SELECT id FROM pf.attempt WHERE task_id=#{task,jdbcType=OTHER} ORDER BY started_at DESC,id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT count(*) FROM pf.execution_stop_receipt s JOIN pf.attempt a ON a.id=s.attempt_id AND a.owner_id=s.owner_id AND a.fencing_token=s.fencing_token WHERE s.task_id=#{task,jdbcType=OTHER} AND s.attempt_id=#{attempt,jdbcType=OTHER}
SELECT count(*) FROM pf.execution_slot WHERE task_id=#{task,jdbcType=OTHER}
SELECT count(*) FROM pf.task n JOIN pf.task t ON n.conversation_id=t.conversation_id WHERE t.id=#{task,jdbcType=OTHER} AND (n.created_at,n.id)>(t.created_at,t.id)

SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM pf.model_call WHERE task_id=#{task,jdbcType=OTHER} AND status IN ('STARTED','UNKNOWN'))+(SELECT count(*) FROM pf.budget_reservation WHERE task_id=#{task,jdbcType=OTHER} AND state='RECONCILING')+(SELECT count(*) FROM pf.tool_operation WHERE task_id=#{task,jdbcType=OTHER} AND status IN ('RUNNING','UNKNOWN'))
SELECT count(*) FROM pf.model_call WHERE task_id=#{task,jdbcType=OTHER}
SELECT clock_timestamp()
mapper.update: UPDATE pf.task SET execution_deadline_at=clock_timestamp()+interval '120 seconds' WHERE id=#{task,jdbcType=OTHER} AND execution_deadline_at IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT id,coalesce(task_ordinal,ordinal) ordinal,status,input_json,round_json FROM pf.model_turn WHERE task_id=#{task,jdbcType=OTHER} ORDER BY coalesce(task_ordinal,ordinal),created_at,id
SELECT id,turn_id,call_json,status,result_json FROM pf.tool_operation WHERE task_id=#{task,jdbcType=OTHER} ORDER BY created_at,id

SELECT jsonb_build_object( 'turns',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',id,'ordinal',coalesce(task_ordinal,ordinal),'status',status,'input',input_json,'inputHash',input_hash,'round',round_json,'hash',content_hash,'callId',accepted_call_id) ORDER BY coalesce(task_ordinal,ordinal),created_at,id) FROM pf.model_turn WHERE task_id=#{task,jdbcType=OTHER}),'[]'::jsonb), 'operations',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',id,'turnId',turn_id,'call',call_json,'hash',call_hash,'status',status,'result',result_json,'resultHash',result_hash) ORDER BY created_at,id) FROM pf.tool_operation WHERE task_id=#{task,jdbcType=OTHER}),'[]'::jsonb), 'calls',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',id,'turnId',turn_id,'ordinal',ordinal,'status',status,'input',input_tokens,'output',output_tokens,'cost',cost_micros,'provider',provider_kind) ORDER BY ordinal,id) FROM pf.model_call WHERE task_id=#{task,jdbcType=OTHER}),'[]'::jsonb))::text
mapper.update: UPDATE pf.budget_account SET reserved_tokens=reserved_tokens+#{tokens},reserved_micros=reserved_micros+#{cost},version=version+1 WHERE space_id=#{space,jdbcType=OTHER} AND user_id=#{user,jdbcType=OTHER} AND reserved_tokens+consumed_tokens+#{tokens}<=token_limit AND reserved_micros+consumed_micros+#{cost}<=cost_limit_micros
mapper.select: SELECT generation FROM pf.execution_dispatch WHERE task_id=#{task,jdbcType=OTHER}
mapper.update: UPDATE pf.checkpoint_recovery SET status='CLAIMED',target_attempt_id=#{attempt,jdbcType=OTHER} WHERE command_id=#{command,jdbcType=OTHER} AND status='QUEUED'
UPDATE pf.checkpoint_recovery SET status=CASE WHEN #{success} THEN 'COMPLETED' ELSE 'FAILED' END,completed_at=clock_timestamp() WHERE target_attempt_id=#{attempt,jdbcType=OTHER} AND status='CLAIMED'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pf.turn_execution_binding(space_id,task_id,attempt_id,turn_id,fencing_token) VALUES(#{lease.spaceId,jdbcType=OTHER},#{lease.taskId,jdbcType=OTHER},#{lease.attemptId,jdbcType=OTHER},#{turn,jdbcType=OTHER},#{lease.fence}) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING

INSERT INTO pf.operation_execution_binding(space_id,task_id,attempt_id,operation_id,fencing_token) VALUES(#{lease.spaceId,jdbcType=OTHER},#{lease.taskId,jdbcType=OTHER},#{lease.attemptId,jdbcType=OTHER},#{operation,jdbcType=OTHER},#{lease.fence}) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT count(*) FROM pf.turn_execution_binding WHERE space_id=#{lease.spaceId,jdbcType=OTHER} AND task_id=#{lease.taskId,jdbcType=OTHER} AND attempt_id=#{lease.attemptId,jdbcType=OTHER} AND turn_id=#{turn,jdbcType=OTHER} AND fencing_token=#{lease.fence}

SELECT count(*) FROM pf.operation_execution_binding b JOIN pf.tool_operation o ON o.id=b.operation_id WHERE b.space_id=#{lease.spaceId,jdbcType=OTHER} AND b.task_id=#{lease.taskId,jdbcType=OTHER} AND b.attempt_id=#{lease.attemptId,jdbcType=OTHER} AND b.fencing_token=#{lease.fence} AND o.call_id=#{call}
mapper.update: UPDATE pf.checkpoint_recovery SET status='FAILED',completed_at=clock_timestamp() WHERE command_id=#{command,jdbcType=OTHER} AND status='QUEUED'
UPDATE pf.message SET status=CASE WHEN coalesce(blocks_json->0->>'text','')='' THEN 'FAILED' ELSE 'PARTIAL' END,version=version+1 WHERE task_id=#{task,jdbcType=OTHER} AND role='ASSISTANT'
